C1323.title: Samsung Engineers Leak Source Code via ChatGPT
C1323.summary: Multiple Samsung engineers used ChatGPT for debugging and development, pasting confidential source code into the public AI tool. OpenAI retains user prompts as training data, exposing Samsung's proprietary information to potential third-party access or unintended reuse, making this a classic case of shadow AI data leakage.
